The API endpoint `/api/stockout/export` is a GET request used to export stockout data. It accepts query parameters `period` and `formatType` to specify the period and format type of the export.

### Response

The response returned has a status code of 500 and a Content-Type of `application/json`. The response body is a JSON object with a key `message` of type string.

}
